subject: Least-privilege authorization evidence — staging instructions
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@medicore.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-14T09:02:00Z
Subject: Request: least-privilege evidence + sample flows for SOC2 SIG

Markus,

Thanks again for the time earlier — MediCore is moving toward our SOC 2 readiness review and the auditor asked for a compact set of artifacts showing how Redwood enforces least-privilege across SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, and RBAC mappings. They specifically want: a) short narrative of the process to extract role-to-principal mappings, b) a small set of SAML assertion samples (both success and failure cases), c) SCIM delta logs that show deprovisioning events, and d) the RBAC ownership matrix with delegated admin notes.

Could you send a concise staging/runbook and a few sample files we can hand to the auditor? We need these in the next two business days. If there are any PII-free samples or anonymized exports you can share, that would be ideal.

-Daniel Park
Security Manager, MediCore Health
security@medicore.com

--
Attachment: request-checklist.pdf (reference)

From: markus_klein@redwood.com
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@medicore.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-14T11:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: least-privilege evidence + sample flows for SOC2 SIG

Daniel —

Appreciate the detailed ask. We can deliver a compact runbook + anonymized artifacts that map exactly to the auditor checklist. High-level plan below; attaching the sample files you can review.

What you will receive (attached and in Drive):
- "staging-runbook.txt": step-by-step extraction workflow for SSO/SAML assertions, SCIM deltas, and RBAC owner matrix.
- SAML assertion examples (success and mismatch): "saml-assertion-samples.txt" (assertion headers redacted).
- SCIM delta example showing a deprovisioning sequence: "scim-delta-log-sample.json" (anonymized user ids).
- RBAC ownership snapshot: "rbac-ownership-matrix.xlsx" (sample roles, owners, and last-attested dates).

Quick notes on process (excerpt from runbook):
1) SAML assertions: use the tracing endpoint in our private console (audit > assertions) to filter by SP-entityID and time range. Exported CSV includes NameID, attributes (email, role), and assertion status. We remove NameIDs and replace with pseudonyms in shared samples.
2) SCIM deltas: the provisioning history service exposes a delta stream; filter by action=DELETE OR active=false and include timestamps and actor (system vs. SCIM push). Our sample shows a completed deprovision within 90s of the SCIM PATCH.
3) RBAC mapping: the ownership matrix is a live export from the roles service. We include columns: role_id, role_name, assigned_principals_count, owner_email, last_attested_at. For auditors we provide a one-page summary and the underlying workbook.

Timing: we can get these artifacts and the runbook to you by EOD tomorrow (2028-06-15) if that works. If the auditor prefers, we can also schedule a 30-min call to walk through the files and the query filters.

Action items for MediCore: confirm you want the files delivered to the Drive link above or via your SFTP endpoint. Also confirm whether the auditor needs raw timestamps in UTC or converted to your local TZ.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Director, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: saml-assertion-samples.txt; scim-delta-log-sample.json; rbac-ownership-matrix.xlsx

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@medicore.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: security@medicore.com
Date: 2028-06-15T07:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: least-privilege evidence + sample flows for SOC2 SIG

Markus —

Thanks, that timeline works. Please drop the artifacts to the Drive folder you listed (we've granted access to security@medicore.com). Auditor prefers UTC timestamps.

One extra ask from the SOC auditor: could you include a brief note per artifact that states: (a) the exact query or filter used to generate it, and (b) any post-processing (anonymization/redaction) performed? They want an auditable trail.

If possible, mark the SAML samples with "successful-login" and "saml-mismatch" labels and include one example where a role attribute was intentionally omitted to show the failure case.

-Daniel

From: markus_klein@redwood.com

Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: 2028-06-16T15:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: least-privilege evidence + sample flows for SOC2 SIG

Daniel —

Files uploaded to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcd_EXAMPLE

Deliverables (short checklist):
- staging-runbook.txt — exact commands/filters used (see excerpt below).
- saml-assertion-samples.txt — two success examples (labelled "successful-login") and one failure example (labelled "saml-mismatch", missing role attribute).
- scim-delta-log-sample.json — anonymized event stream demonstrating deprovision flow and actor metadata.
- rbac-ownership-matrix.xlsx — role -> owner -> last_attested mapping and a one-page attestation summary.

Excerpt from staging-runbook.txt (copy of verbatim lines we used to extract artifacts):
1) SAML assertions (UTC): query audit.assertions where sp_entity = 'redwood:medi_core' and timestamp >= '2028-05-01T00:00:00Z' and timestamp <= '2028-05-31T23:59:59Z' select (name_id, attributes.email, attributes.role, assertion_status) | redact(name_id) -> replace(name_id, 'anon-user-###')
2) SCIM delta: call provisioning.delta(stream_id) filter (action in ['DELETE','PATCH'] and target_path contains '/active') map (user_id -> pseudonym, timestamp, actor_type, change_set)
3) RBAC snapshot: roles.export_csv(filter='last_attested >= 2027-12-01') -> rbac-ownership-matrix.xlsx

Post-processing notes: all NameIDs and user emails were replaced with pseudonyms for shared files; internal service account IDs are left but hashed. Timestamps remained in UTC per request. No change to assertion_status fields.

If the auditor wants a short walkthrough, Jordan and I are available tomorrow 10:00–12:00 ET. Irene will prepare a 1-page attestation memo linking each artifact to the auditor checklist.

Let me know if you need additional samples or a longer timeframe for access to raw logs.

Best,
Markus

--
Attachments (uploaded): saml-assertion-samples.txt (3 samples), scim-delta-log-sample.json (1 file), rbac-ownership-matrix.xlsx (1 workbook)
